slices.focus: Quarter-end shows real denial improvement; Kelli pushes for monthly payer drill-downs and clinic signoff.
slices.summary: Quarter-end figures show first-pass denials dropping enough to ease payroll panic. Kelli capitalizes on this by pushing for and winning monthly payer drill-down meetings (insurer-by-insurer review) and a standing requirement that each clinic lead sign off on repeat registration and authorization errors. The signoff trail shifts accountability from billing-as-cleanup to site-level ownership.
